items.title: Profile migration that survives locked files
items.description: Windows can no longer block startup when the previous profile folder is briefly locked. The profile is copied when rename is refused, and leftover legacy folders are retired on macOS.

items.title: Clearer service availability errors
items.description: When the VPN service API is unavailable from the current network location (HTTP 451), Predator VPN shows a clear message and uses the system proxy for those API calls when one is configured.

items.title: Reliable account sign-in
items.description: Desktop sign-in uses a browser-matching TLS helper so the account edge accepts login and OAuth token exchange, with an in-app image CAPTCHA form when required.

items.title: A redesigned Predator VPN
items.description: Purpose-built desktop and phone interfaces with clearer connection, account, location, and diagnostics controls.

items.title: Ten cohesive accent palettes
items.description: Orange remains the default; Gold and eight other color choices now apply throughout the interface, including the connection button.
